# GPU/Frame

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [ComputePass.h](ComputePass.h): What an indirect dispatch reads out of a buffer: three threadgroup counts. (declares `DispatchArguments`, `DispatchOrder`, `ComputePass`)
- [Frame.h](Frame.h): What a pass does with the depth and stencil planes it is handed - the load at its start and the store at its end, which are one decision because the second is only worth paying for when a later pass makes the first one Load. (declares `DepthAction`, `DepthTarget`, `RenderPassDescriptor`, `ColorTarget`, `OffscreenTarget`, `FrameNesting`, `Frame`)
- [IndirectDraw.h](IndirectDraw.h): What RenderPass::drawIndirect reads out of a buffer for one draw: Metal's MTLDrawPrimitivesIndirectArguments, Vulkan's VkDrawIndirectCommand and D3D12's D3D12_DRAW_ARGUMENTS, which are the same four 32-bit integers in the same order, so a kernel writing one writes it for every backend. (declares `DrawArguments`, `DrawIndexedArguments`)
- [IndirectDrawPlan.h](IndirectDrawPlan.h): A run of indirect draws the checks passed: where the first record starts, how many there are, and the byte step between them. (declares `IndirectDrawPlan`, `planIndirectDraws`, `isValidDrawCountBuffer`, `traceIndirectCountUnsupported`)
- [OcclusionQueries.h](OcclusionQueries.h): What an occlusion query counts. (declares `OcclusionMode`, `OcclusionQueries`)
- [RenderPass.h](RenderPass.h): Records draw commands for a single render pass (MTLRenderCommandEncoder on Metal). (declares `RenderPass`)

<!-- agent-docs:end -->
